sharedRules.name: Not One Step Back
sharedRules.description: Soviet armies can include commisars as noted in the list. Commisars are political officers and do not confer a morale bonus to nearby troops. However, when a friendly infantry unit fails an order test within 6" of a commissar, remove one model from the unit and re-roll the test. Note there is no choice in the matter - if the commissar is within 6" of the unit he will shoot any dissenters he finds. The second result stands as normal. ONly one re-roll is made in theis manner per orer test. This rule only applies to infantry, and units of two or less models are exempt.
